integrity: The universal statement is proved by an exact four-region count of distinguishing vertices and elementary minimization; finite computation is used only as a replay on small ranks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats finite direct products of fields, whose annihilating-ideal graphs are strong Boolean graphs.
It does not determine the threshold for arbitrary blow-ups of strong Boolean graphs or for nonreduced rings.
An equivalent formula may exist in unindexed literature under another name for the Boolean disjointness graph.
title: Metric-dimension threshold of semisimple annihilating-ideal graphs
